shortDescription: Attach a disk from a snapshot to a VM on HyperCore API.

options.name: force_reboot
options.description: Can VM be forced to power off and on. Only used when modifications to the VM require it to be powered off and VM does not respond to a shutdown request within I(shutdown_timeout) limit. Before this is utilized, a shutdown request is sent.

options.name: shutdown_timeout
options.description: How long does ansible controller wait for VMs response to a shutdown request. In seconds.

options.name: source_disk_slot
options.description: Specify a disk slot from source snapshot to identify source disk.

options.name: source_disk_type
options.description: Specify a disk type from source snapshot.

options.name: source_snapshot_uuid
options.description: UUID of the snapshot we want to use on a VM.

options.name: vm_disk_slot
options.description: Specify a disk slot from a vm to identify destination disk. Note that this MUST be a next free slot or an already used slot for the given disk_type. Otherwise VM might not boot.

options.name: vm_disk_type
options.description: Type of disk on the VM that we want to attach a VM snapshot disk to.

options.name: vm_name
options.description: Name of the VM we want to attach a VM snapshot disk to.
